text:
Ana: Heads-up — AcmePulse submitted their DPA + SOC2 questionnaire and flagged a few risky items (embeddings retention, BYOK provenance, non-prod access). They want answers before renewal next month. I attached their PDF to the thread. Please triage who owns what.

Tyler: can you paste the specific questions they called out? quick skim helps.

Ana: Key asks pasted below:
- Embeddings retention policy and ability to set tenant-level retention (they want 90 days)
- BYOK: proof of key provenance / supported KMS list
- Non-prod data handling: subprocessor list + masked sandbox options
- SOC2 scope confirmation (prod regions + infra vendors)

Priya: assigning to security for review. I'll take the BYOK + infra vendor evidence. ETA: EOD tomorrow if nothing blocks.

Sam: legal wants to review any DPA clause edits for retention/BYOK. I'll draft suggested language once security confirms constraints.

Rhys: I'll own customer comms and run the enablement session once we have a proposed answer set. Ana — what's their exact timeline?

Ana: Renewal notice is 2026-04-11; they asked for answers within 5 business days (so ~2026-04-06).

Priya: Security quick notes: Hosted Redwood does NOT currently offer customer-managed keys for hosted tenants — BYOK is only available on Private/Dedicated with KMS integrations. We can provide attestations for our KMS (GCP KMS / AWS KMS) and key rotation logs. Need to confirm whether they require HSM-backed provenance.

Tyler: Embeddings retention — platform supports tenant_override: default 30d; can be extended to 90d with contractual exception and a config flip. I'll prepare the config + audit log evidence.

Tyler: snippet for ops team:
```PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}
{
  "embeddings_retention_days": 90
}
```

Priya: For SOC2 infra proof I need the vendor list + SOC2 report links for infra vendors (db, object store, monitoring). @Ana can you attach the infra vendor list from onboarding?

Ana: uploading onboarding infra list now -> https://drive.internal/acmepulse-onboard (attachment).

DPA Bot: Document uploaded: /evidence/acmepulse/2026-03-dpa-questionnaire.pdf — sha256: ab12... (automated).

Sam: Plan for legal: I'll draft DPA addendum with two retention options (30d default, 90d extended option) and a BYOK clause that calls out Private/Dedicated limitation + migration path. Target draft by Fri EOD.

Rhys: Once Priya + Tyler confirm technical constraints, I'll prepare a short one-pager for the CSM call with the options and risks, then schedule a 30m sync with the customer. Prefer to get everything reviewed internally by 2026-04-05.

Priya: Action items for security: 1) Confirm KMS list and rotation logs 2) Confirm ability to provide written attestation for BYOK limitations 3) Validate that masked sandbox options meet their non-prod requirements. I'll post evidence links in this thread.

Tyler: I'll attach the config guide + recent audit logs for retention change (redacted): https://internal/ops/artifacts/emb-retention-2026-03.zip

Ana: Thanks — timeline checks out. I'll update the customer ticket and set expectation that we'll respond by 2026-04-06.

Sam: small note — legal will need the exact customer wording preferences for BYOK (do they want exclusive BYOK or will a hybrid model be acceptable?). Rhys, can you ask during the call?

Rhys: yep will ask. Also I'll include a feedback capture question about product docs clarity — they noted docs on retention were confusing.

Priya: Quick blocker: if they insist on BYOK for hosted, we need CS + Sales escalation; hosting model constraint is non-negotiable without dedicated/private commitment. Flagging as renewal risk. :warning:

Ana: Marking renewal risk = medium-high. I'll loop in acct exec after draft responses.

Tyler: ack — prepping artifacts now.

Sam: ack.

Rhys: I'll draft the customer-facing email once legal posts the DPA addendum. Target to send by Tue 2026-04-06. :thumbsup:

Ana: perfect — thanks team.

DPA Bot: Reminder set: follow-up reminder 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC for internal signoff.
